content: Me niŋ Bepaŋdi tubulodaaŋ yahehewe timindok ninadiguk
Bepaŋne, du me mikneye kohohik gineniŋ kotigoŋ nehikibidali nanagit hinek tibeŋ. Du nabu-ulidokoweŋ kaŋ adi mu nehitubu-kadakaneŋ.
Du me kadakahi kohohik gineniŋ nehikibidaleŋ, unduŋ tiŋa me heki menaŋgat nanaŋ tiiŋ heki’walaŋ kohohik gineniŋ kotigoŋ nanagileŋ.
U yabeŋ, adi yadi nu nulukumundok kabup woomhakiiŋ. Me kadakahi uyadi me mik molo heki, adi yadi nukut mik titiŋdok bopneiŋ. Yahwe, nu kadakaniŋ nemu tiyemilat.
Yodoko Medege u kahaŋinda mu tilat. Tiŋa undugoŋ, nu nemek nemu tibene kadakaguk. Iŋgoŋ adi yadi nukut mik titiŋdok pilap hinek wooŋ woomnamiiŋ.

Yahwe, Saŋiniŋ Molom, pilap hinek buŋa nehitubu-lodaweŋ. Isilaehi’walaŋ Bepaŋ, du meheki i yabeŋ. Du pilap buŋa metambop hogohogok i malabumuŋ yembeŋ, du aditok bulaniŋgoŋ adi mu nadiyembeŋ. Du metambop titiŋ momooŋ titiŋdok yokamandaaŋ wooŋ titiŋ hogohi titiŋdok nadiiŋ, adi hekidok adi kibikoŋhik tubu-udane hinek tiyembeŋ.
Adi timiŋ kotigoŋ udaneeŋ buŋa yokwet wapum diniŋ gimbahaŋ kelemadiŋa kamo hekidi tombulumbulume tiiŋ unduŋ toyawiiŋ.
U nadiweŋ. Medehik adi hogoli hinehinek, miknoŋ niŋ maŋiŋnit nabugoŋ. Iŋgoŋ nehi adi indiŋ yoiŋ, “Nebek nemu nadinimilak ale.”
Iŋgoŋ Yahwe, du adi yabugege tilaŋ, tiŋa metambop hogohogok u yenimpekit tilaŋ.
Da kubugoŋdi saŋiniŋ namuŋa nabudokolaŋ. Bepaŋ, nu memik heki yabu-momoŋ tiŋa du’walaŋkade bulat, du kubugoŋdi hebihat kwetne tilaŋ.
Bepaŋ adi nabukahile hinek tilak, doktiŋa adi negoŋ buŋa nehitubu-lodawek. Adi nu binabune hogok yakawene negoŋ memikneye yehibefooŋ yalakapmewaak.

Bepaŋ, metamneye adi nemek i maŋgoŋde tiŋa mintalak u kaule tineeneŋ, doktiŋa memikneye u mu widihikumumbeŋ. Wapum, du adi indi’walaŋ yahehewenik, ale da’walaŋ saŋiniŋgedi memik heki yehikelekula yehitubu-kadakaweŋ.
Helemahelemaŋ, adi yadi kadakaniŋ titiŋdok hogok yoiŋ. Ale biyabune nehi’walaŋ fokohik doktiŋa malabumuŋ hekineŋ. Adi yadi helemahelemaŋ yalaŋ mede yoiŋ, tiŋa du wohoge foloŋ medehaki yoiŋ.

Du wondoktiŋa nadikadakayemiŋa widihikumumbeŋ. Me kadakahi u yehitubu-liwedapmaŋ hinek tibeŋ. Du unduŋ tibeŋ kaŋ metam hogohogokdi indiŋ nadineŋ: Du Bepaŋ, Isilaehi’walaŋ Mapme hatilaŋ eŋ kwetkwet diniŋ Mapme.
Adi timiŋ kotigoŋ udaneeŋ buŋa yokwet wapum diniŋ gimbahaŋ kelemadiŋa kamo hekidi tombulumbulume tiiŋ unduŋ toyawiiŋ.
Nanaŋedok nadiŋa woŋambuŋat tiiŋ, ala welehik mu tokilak kaŋ uŋgoŋ hali mede wapum toiŋ.

Iŋgoŋ nu adi saŋiniŋge wapum wendok yobihila kap gineŋ tobit. Nu koom malabumuŋ mebimebi mintanambune dagoŋ yahehewe tinamuŋa nabudokoguŋ. Wendok nadiŋa nu helemahelemaŋ haniŋ timiŋ kap wapum toluwaat.
Bepaŋ, da kubugoŋdi saŋiniŋne, wendoktiŋa nu kap toŋa wohoge ganintiloit. Bepaŋ, du adi nabukahile hinek tilaŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ, hebihatnedok kwet adi da kubugoŋ hinek.
